le plugin archiplus a été développé sous: The archiplus plugin was developed on Debian 12 and does not use jQuery (nor do the third-party libraries it uses). It complies with Jeedom's development standards. The archiplus class code is highly structured and extensively documented: the plugin's author will review all suggestions for corrections or improvements.
